title: Folded light
sampleTitle: Build AI your team can use.
principle: Light gives a simple material depth; an oversized crop supplies the movement.
typography: Open sentence case, medium weight · generated concept lettering
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished editorial blog thumbnail for Recoup, a sophisticated AI strategy and software company for music-business executives and institutional investors. Landscape 16:9, 1920 by 1080. A flat, full-bleed graphic design artifact, not a picture of a poster, not a website mockup. Beautiful art direction like a commissioned cultural journal cover with restraint and strong legibility at 360px wide. Brand palette: clear blue #007EBD or deeper blue #0565BB, electric pale lime #D6FF62, deep forest #132B26, icy cyan #C2EDFF, paper white. Use only the subset specified. Typography: modern DM Sans-like sans serif, clean coherent letterforms, careful tracking and intentional line breaks. No logos, no small footer, no bylines, no category labels, no extra text. No photoreal scenes, humans, musicians, audio gear, robots, data dashboards, cartoon clipart, network nodes, corner sine waves, or rounded interlocking block motifs. Do not imitate any particular company's identity. Approximately 80% of the canvas should read as one dominant color, with a generous quiet text area. Use slight fine print texture and purposeful, local tonal variation, not a generic full-frame blue-to-lime gradient.
CONCEPT: FOLDED LIGHT. Dominant rich blue. On the far right, a monumental abstract pleated paper fan made from just four or five broad irregular folded planes rises from the lower edge and is cropped by the right edge. It is sculptural but clearly a stylized paper illustration, not photographic. Rich blue faces, one pale cyan fold lit softly, one very small lime fold edge. Sweeping diagonal folds, not rectangular stair steps. Fine matte surface, gentle diffused ink shadows. The left 65% remains completely calm blue, no shapes behind words. Headline in large white, medium-weight sentence case, aligned left in the upper-middle, three precise lines: "Build AI" / "your team" / "can use." Keep about 7% outer margin. Folds take no more than 28% total area. Expensive editorial simplicity.
description: Light gives a simple material depth; an oversized crop supplies the movement.

title: Ink impression
sampleTitle: Turn repeated work into a system.
principle: One large ink impression adds energy through its crop, texture, and imperfect edge.
typography: Clear white headline beside an oversized print · generated concept lettering
prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Generate ONE finished Recoup editorial blog thumbnail, 16:9 landscape 1920x1080. A contemporary screenprinted cultural journal cover, not a poster photographed in a room. Dominant clear blue #007EBD covers 80% of the canvas. Across the far right 22% of the frame, one expressive abstract LIME INK IMPRESSION: a huge off-axis elongated imperfect oval, cropped severely by top and right edges, with ragged but elegant squeegee edge and a few narrow negative slits inside it. One bold irregular gesture made by pressed ink. An offset darker blue impression gives subtle overlapping print depth. Flat graphic, not a curved block or ribbon, no scatter of dots, no concentric circles or waves, no triangles, no music equipment or figurative subjects. The left and lower-center remain calm blue with very faint matte grain. EXACT headline, white clean modern DM Sans-like type, three lines "Turn repeated" / "work into" / "a system." Large medium-bold at left, with 7% clear margins. A tiny forest ink rectangle peeks from the bottom edge under the main impression. The big lime form supplies the energy, the typography is calm and highly legible. Strong asymmetry, huge crop, a tactile analog texture on the graphic, no noisy background or full-frame gradient. No logos, footer, categories, or extra text.
description: One large ink impression adds energy through its crop, texture, and imperfect edge.
